description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing notes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, using Flask and Flask-Smorest.

classes.name: NoteSchema
classes.description: Schema for serializing and deserializing note data, including fields for id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.

classes.name: NoteUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating note data, allowing optional title and content fields.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: MethodView class handling GET and POST requests for the /notes endpoint to list all notes and create new notes.

classes.name: NotesDetail
classes.description: MethodView class handling GET, PUT, and DELETE requests for individual notes identified by note_id.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all notes or retrieve a specific note by id.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing note identified by note_id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a note by id.
